comment: Deployable instrument versions, copied into public/instruments at build time. Paths are relative to the repository root. Add a new version here only after it validates (tools/phase0_scripts/validate.py).
system_fill_comment: On a school link these questions are not shown; the server fills them on submit from the school record (DEC-24). Never used in preview mode.
route_check_comment: Student instruments: the question that asks the class, and which option code means which class. The server flags ROUTE_CLASS_MISMATCH when it differs from the class chosen on the landing page (never blocks).
research_permission_comment: Instruments with a research-use question (settings.research_permission_gate): the option codes that mean 'yes, you may use my answers'. Research exports include only those rows (DEC-30). Instruments without a gate are always included.
